name: 33-dim-room-light-no-ceilings
incident: 2026-10-04 review: escalation rationed by probe_min_gap_s repeated the silent probe every tick, and the audible probe re-anchored on the stale reference
description: A dark room at night on a dump without gain ceilings (AE reserve unknown). The boot silent probe confirms night (r=4) and anchors the reference at ~2000. At t=300 a dim room light comes on: the night pipeline steps 2000 -> 900, the illuminator-off curve reads the same 900 (r~1), and the day pipeline stays dark (6000 > night_gain), so the honest answer is night. Path C fires, the silent probe reads r~1 with unknown reserve and escalates to the audible probe, which finds night. At t=600 a second lamp takes it to 400 - inside probe_min_gap_s of that probe, so the next escalation is rationed. Two defects turned this into a loop. The audible probe's pre-level was the reset smoother, so pre_probe fell back to the old reference and the revert re-anchored ~2000 - path C fired again at once. And an escalation rationed by probe_min_gap_s was simply dropped, so the next tick asked the silent probe again. Measured on the pre-fix build: 295 silent probes and 12 board drives (an audible day/night pair every 600 s) in this hour. Now the lit level is the probe's pre-level (the reference follows the scene to ~900 and then ~400), and a rationed escalation holds the silent probe until the ration allows the audible one: two pairs, four silent probes.

expect_log: boot: night confirmed by the silent probe
AE reserve is unknown - cannot tell a lit room from a railed meter
